name: Bella Furniture | Marbella Designs
old_description: where custom upholstery is made with care, purpose, and lasting quality
about:
Bella Furniture, operating under the Marbella Designs name, is a family-owned furniture manufacturer based in Bell Gardens, California, in the greater Los Angeles area. The company describes itself as having decades of experience in the art of upholstered furniture, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. It began as a maker of custom upholstery with a focus on craftsmanship and modern design.

The shop produces custom upholstery including tailored sofas, sectionals, pillows, and custom seating for hospitality and commercial spaces. Each piece is designed and built by hand, combining traditional craftsmanship with a modern point of view. The company offers flexibility in scale, fabric, and design, working closely with clients to bring their vision to life. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

Bella Furniture serves the hospitality and commercial sectors, providing custom seating for hotels, restaurants, and other gathering spaces, while also supplying residential clients with made-to-order sofas and sectionals. The company emphasizes collaboration with designers and specifiers to meet project-specific requirements.

The company states that its work reflects a commitment to quality materials and responsible production, with every piece proudly made in California. It values craftsmanship, honesty in materials, and creating furniture that feels as good as it looks, positioning itself as a maker of lasting, comfortable pieces.
